objective: Fix every seam deviation from the T05 consistency report so the wired system (API + pool + store + lifecycle) matches contracts C1-C6, changing leaf code only within its owned paths and re-running the affected leaf tests

allowed_dependencies.what: may patch app/db/models.py + app/services/job_store.py for seam defects only (owns_fixes_for)
may patch app/services/report_worker.py for seam defects only (owns_fixes_for)
may patch app/api/routes/reports.py for seam defects only (owns_fixes_for)
may patch app/main.py + app/services/recovery.py for seam defects only (owns_fixes_for)

non_goals: No new features, no refactors beyond the deviation list, no style cleanup
Do not modify contracts — a defect that is actually a contract error is a CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST, not a fix
Do not re-run the consistency sweep from scratch (consume T05's report; re-run only the affected checks)
implementation_constraints: Every patch is traceable to a T05 report entry (record the mapping in the checkpoint)
Leaf-module patches under owns_fixes_for are T06's authorized scope, not a scope deviation — but they stay limited to seam defects
After each leaf patch, re-run that leaf's own test suite; a leaf suite that regresses stops the fix loop
If the deviation list is large (> 10 entries), checkpoint_and_split per seam S1/S2/S3 before starting fixes (per risk warning)

deliverables.what: seam fixes across the four leaves (each mapped to a T05 entry)

acceptance_tests.description: after fixes, the full test suites of T01-T04 stay green: pytest tests/services tests/api tests/test_startup_recovery.py -q exits 0
the T05 consistency report re-run writes 'no deviations' for every previously reported entry
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/integration/test_contract_consistency.py -q exits 0 and report lists each prior entry as resolved

acceptance_tests.description: a seam defect whose correct fix would require changing a frozen contract is NOT patched: it is emitted as a CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST blocker
acceptance_tests.evidence: checkpoint T06 contains a blockers entry of kind CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST when such a defect exists (test fixture scenario in the execution trace)

failure_cases.scenario: a reported deviation is ambiguous (T05 marked it unresolved)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: the ambiguous entry is escalated in the checkpoint as a blocker of kind CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST — a test fixture scenario asserts this (V1: stop + user decision); do not guess the intended spec

failure_cases.scenario: a fix in one leaf breaks another leaf's suite
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record the interaction in deviations, fix at the seam (not by weakening the other leaf's test), re-run both suites

handoff.notes: verified_facts must list every fix with (T05 entry id, file, change, leaf suite re-run result) — T07's gates assume a consistent system

warnings.detail: fix scope is proportional to T05's diff, which is unknown before T05 runs
warnings.rationale: if the consistency diff is large, checkpoint_and_split per seam (S1/S2/S3) before starting fixes; owned fix rights are already per-leaf in owns_fixes_for
